items.title: How much extra engineering time does div-soup actually cost?
items.description: L2's own numbers: hand-rolling one interactive div's accessibility (tabindex, a two-key keydown handler, an ARIA role, and disabled-state handling) costs roughly 34 minutes of implement-and-test time. A real button costs 0 for all of it. Move the sliders to see how the gap scales as a page grows.
